title: Haemonetics to Present at Bank of America 2026 Healthcare Conference
summary: BOSTON, May 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Haemonetics Corporation (NYSE: HAE) announced that Chris Simon, President and CEO, will participate in a fireside chat with investors at the Bank of America 2026 Healthcare Conference on Tuesday, May 12, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. PT.
body_markdown:
BOSTON


, May 5, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Haemonetics Corporation (NYSE: HAE) announced that Chris Simon, President and CEO, will participate in a fireside chat with investors at the Bank of America 2026 Healthcare Conference on Tuesday, May 12, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. PT.


The public may access a live webcast of the fireside chat at Haemonetics' Investor Relations website or at the following link:[https://bofa.veracast.com/webcasts/bofa/healthcare2026/75d0U1.cfm](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4680418-1&h=3437509011&u=https%3A%2F%2Fbofa.veracast.com%2Fwebcasts%2Fbofa%2Fhealthcare2026%2F75d0U1.cfm&a=https%3A%2F%2Fbofa.veracast.com%2Fwebcasts%2Fbofa%2Fhealthcare2026%2F75d0U1.cfm) .


A replay of the recorded webcast will become accessible within 24 hours after the event and will be available for one year on Haemonetics' Investor Relations website.


**ABOUT HAEMONETICS**


Haemonetics is a global medical technology company dedicated to improving the quality, effectiveness and efficiency of health care. Our innovative solutions addressing critical medical needs include a suite of hospital technologies designed to advance standards of care and help enhance outcomes for patients; end-to-end plasma collection technologies to optimize operations for plasma centers; and products to enable blood centers to collect in-demand blood components. To learn more about Haemonetics, visit[www.haemonetics.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4680418-1&h=4056154738&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.haemonetics.com%2F&a=www.haemonetics.com) .
